gaps: GAP-007: always zero, no real sequence tracking

producer_paths.name: CLI vb submit (RunSubmission)
locks: write_lock acquired at submission.rs:145 before staging
producer_paths.seq_notes: events carry hardcoded seq 0/1, not journal-allocated

producer_paths.name: JournalWriteBatch.put_compiled_ir
producer_paths.notes: stages for batch commit, no immediate I/O

verification_path.notes: cold-path re-verification, does not persist or modify seq

reconstruction_path.notes: reconstructs from journal records, always sets seq 0

runtime_event_seq.note: runtime shard path uses dynamic per-run event seq allocation

lock_acquisition.recursive_lock_risk: if counter allocation acquires write_lock while already held → deadlock

seq_assignment_candidate.timing: call alloc before prepare_compiled_artifact, pass seq to new variant
seq_assignment_candidate.rationale: seq becomes part of artifact envelope, included in digest binding

risks: Key space collision if counter stored under compiled IR key prefix
Type confusion if counter type differs from EventSeq
Hash integrity broken if seq changed after envelope formation
Write lock deadlock if counter allocation re-acquires write_lock

legacy_compatibility.note: all existing artifacts have seq 0; new scheme must remain readable
